summary: Iter58 re-verified Trust Strip / Marquee (kata berjalan) / Announcement Bar CMS on RESTORED environment. Backend: 7/7 pytest passed against public URL (backend/tests/test_iter57_trust_marquee_announcement.py). Public GET /api/content returns registry defaults (trust: Sejak 1970 award /tentang, Biang Impor Pilihan shield-check, 3 Cabang di Bandung map-pin /lokasi; marquee_words items ELEGAN..; announcement items). PUT + revert cycle validated. Frontend UI (NEW coverage vs iter57): logged in as admin via /admin (data-testid admin-login-*), navigated to /admin/konten, edited each section THROUGH THE UI FORM EDITOR (not API): (1) Trust: changed item[0] title -> 'UI_TEST_TRUST_A' and icon select -> 'flame', clicked Publish; homepage [data-testid=trust-strip] rendered new title within seconds. cms-rep-add-items button present. (2) Marquee (marquee_words): changed items[0] via cms-list-items-0 -> 'UI_MARQ_TEST', speed=fast, style=dark, Publish; /marquee-strip on homepage contained 'UI_MARQ_TEST'. (3) Announcement: items[0] -> 'UI_ANN_TEST', speed=slow, Publish; [data-testid=announcement-bar] on homepage contained 'UI_ANN_TEST' and .cp-marquee-track class contained 'slow'. minor.issue: 500 AttributeError: module 'services.catalog' has no attribute 'list_reviews'. Seen repeatedly in backend logs while browsing storefront / product pages. Function exists in services.admin_reviews and services.stores (list_reviews_admin) but not exposed as services.catalog.list_reviews. Not part of CMS scope but visible as console 500s on frontend. Fix: import/rebind in services/catalog.py or update router to call services.admin_reviews.list_reviews.
